out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES REVIEW AND SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES REVIEW AND POST FOR USE WHEN REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: MEAT SLICER WITH FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE MEAT SLICER AND OTHER EQUIPMENT ARE PROPERLY CLEANED AND SANITIZED AFTER USE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CUT TOMATOES AT 57F, PROVOLONE AT 58F, SLICED CHEDDAR AT 56F, FETA AT 56F AND COOKED STEAK AT 56F IN ELINE 2 DOOR PREP TOP; SHREDDED MOZZARELLA AT 45F, DICED TOMATOES AT 51F, BEEF AT. 51F, SAUSAGE AT 50F, COOKED CHICKEN AT 51F IN TURBO AIR 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL SERVICED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. PIZZA BOLI'S AT LANDMARK (Inspection Date: 11/04/2026) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: MILK AND SOUR CREAM IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: HAM AND ALFREDO SAUCE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE DATE MARKED AND UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS ARE DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: COOKED CHICKEN AND COOKED WINGS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE DATE MARKED AND UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS ARE DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: CLEANING CHEMICALS STORED WITH BOTTLES OF SAUCES AND PIZZA TRAYS UNDER PREP TABLE NEXT TO HAND WASH SINK IN FRONT KITCHEN AREA.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED CHEMICALS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: ELINE 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE UNIT THERMOMETER. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. PIZZA BOLI'S AT LANDMARK (Inspection Date: 11/04/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED SMALL FLIES IN BACK KITCHEN OVER 3 COMPARTMENT AND HANDWASH SINKS; OBSERVED DIFFERENT STAGES OF LIVE COCKROACHES UNDER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, WALLS OVER 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, WALL OVER 3 DOOR PREP TOP AND ON 3 DOOR PREP TOP. NO CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE REPORT WAS AVAILABLE FOR REVIEW.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL SERVICE AND CLEAN AND SANITIZE FOOD CONTACT SURFACES BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the BASE OF KITCHEN BACK DOOR; GAPS AROUND UTILITY LINES AND MISSING CEILING TILES ABOVE WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REPLACE MISSING CEILING TILES, SEAL BACK DOOR AND GAPS IN CEILING TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PESTS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES IN FRONT AREA AND FOODS STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE TO PIC IN PREPARATION OF SANITIZER BUCKET WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION. PLEASE ENSURE SANITIZER BUCKETS ARE PREPARED AT START OF SHIFT TO SANITIZE FOOD PREP AREAS BEFORE ENGAGING IN FOOD PREPARATION ACTIVITIES. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean PIZZA BOXES were stored DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN FRONT AREA LEFT OF CASHIER STATION in an manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: pizza sauce
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. PIC ADDED LABEL.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT A CFM MUST BE AT THE RESTAURANT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.
